content.text: I fixed the bug in `solution/util.py`, and the visible suite now passes (3 tests). The `_NAME` regex was `[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*?`. The trailing `?` made the quantifier lazy, so it matched only the first character of a placeholder name. `render` in `core.py` then found no closing `}` right after that character and raised "malformed placeholder". I removed the `?` so the regex matches the whole name. `core.py` is unchanged.
